channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida roads
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans will have traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5, marking an all-time high for the holiday.

item.title: Juno Beach considers fence replacement at JB-7 beach access after Colony Condos residents report trespassing problems
item.description: A missing fence at a Juno Beach public beach access point is creating tension between Colony Condos residents and summer beachgoers, with a fix potentially costing the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, marking the city as the only Florida winner this year.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A rating with record 93.5% graduation rate
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B.

item.title: Martin County School Board challenges judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectru.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year, hamburgers and buns among biggest increases
item.description: According to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey, a holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago.

item.description: The Martin County School Board is challenging a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher who was suspended following controversial social media comments about conservative activist Charlie Kirk. item.title: Port St. Lucie expands Midway Road, adds Florida Turnpike interchange to ease congestion
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike on Midway Road.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with global artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain in Fort Pierce while connecting local and international artists through an artist-in-residency program.

item.title: Hobe Sound community rallies around man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside a Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance rebuild.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescued two boaters Wednesday after their small motorized boat sank in the Intracoastal Waterway. Both were wearing life jackets.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as inflation drives up hamburgers, buns and berries
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation that doubles boat capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long renovation project expected to be completed by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday because of a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is setting its sights on a state championship heading into the 2026 fall season. item.title: North Palm Beach Celebrates Independence Day with Fireworks and America 250 Events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors celebrated Independence Day with family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Southwest Florida communities celebrate America's 250th with fireworks and parades
item.description: Cities across Southwest Florida hosted Fourth of July festivities including fireworks displays, drone shows, and waterfront celebrations marking the semiquincentennial.
